result:
test-phase-05 (US4, Todo Plans) passed on its first attempt. All 25 checks passed, none were unclear, and no bugs were filed.

- **API, 12 checks via curl:**
  - Creating a plan works, and bad input is rejected: a plan with no items, a missing source or a deleted source is refused, and so is an end time equal to or before the start.
  - Ticking items updates progress, and the Dashboard shows it on the next read. Only task items change their source: ticking one marks the task Done, and un-ticking leaves it Done. Habit and learning items change nothing.
  - Status is worked out correctly as Not Started, In Progress or Completed, including going back to In Progress after an un-tick. The rest time counts down between two reads.
  - Active plans are grouped and ordered by priority, and completed plans show their percentage.
  - Deleting a source keeps its item in the plan, marked as removed and still counted. Deleting a plan leaves its tasks, habits and cards unchanged.
- **UI, 13 checks via Playwright, headless:**
  - The empty state and `/plans?add=1` both open the plan builder, and the item and end-time error messages save nothing.
  - Progress updates as soon as an item is ticked, and the rest time counts down on screen.
  - I tested the start notification in real time: a plan set to start at 13:13:00 showed its notice and "Started" highlight at 13:13:00.75 without a page reload.
  - After a reload the page matches the API. Grouping and order are right, and editing, deleting, the removed-item badge and the nav link all work.

A few things I noted in the report but didn't file as bugs:
- Two of three items done shows as 66%. The requirements ask for a whole percentage but don't say how to round, so I only checked values that don't depend on rounding.
- A plan completed early by ticking every item still returns a rest time from the API. The swagger allows this. The UI contract says the rest time shows only while a plan is In Progress, but no check in this phase covers that case on the page.
- When the start notification appeared, the plan card still read Not Started for up to 8 seconds before switching to In Progress.

Unit tests weren't part of this phase; they run in the regression phase. In `suite.json`, test-phase-05 is now `done`, and the checklist, `progress.md` and screenshots are written. The next phase is test-phase-06 (US5, Dashboard).

Files are in `loops/testing/`:
- test-phase-05-report.md (under `outputs/001-quickflow/suite/`)
- suite.json (under `state/001-quickflow/`)
- evidence folder `runs/001-quickflow/suite/test-phase-05/attempt-1/`: `curl.log`, `ui-results.json`, `shot-01..15-*.png`
